note: Voice Forge cast (tools/voice_forge/README.md). speaker id (Speakers.TABLE / Events.dialogue) -> Kokoro v1.0 voice + speed. voice = an id (af_/am_ American F/M, bf_/bm_ British F/M) or a blend {id: weight}. lang defaults from the prefix (b* = en-gb). Changing voice or speed re-renders that speaker's lines on the next build. `audition` = the candidates rendered by `run_voice_forge.ps1 audition` (docs/tools/voice_forge/auditions/). Cast approved by JS 2026-09-27 (Malrik = bm_george, heard and liked).
audition_line: The crown is not lost. It is only waiting for the right hands.

vessa.notes: Fire, young American woman: quick, bright, impatient. Speed 1.12 keeps most mission lines inside the 5 s dialogue box.
vessa.audition_line: Three braziers, one seal. How hard can it be to light things?

malrik.notes: Shadow, deep British man. bm_george chosen by JS. Speed 1.05: 0.9 overran most Ep3 slots in the first comparison, 1.0 still overran 4 of 15.
malrik.audition_line: Light all the candles you like. The dark just gets a better view.

torvald.notes: Ice, older British man: slow, weary, patient.
torvald.audition_line: A hundred winters I have kept this gate. I can keep it one more.

ysolde.notes: Nature, young British woman: calm, warm, stubborn.
ysolde.audition_line: Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

vey.notes: Old Vey, the Storm-Sword: old British man, gravel and humour. A daniel / lewis blend at 0.85 (older and slower than Torvald's plain lewis, 99 Hz).
vey.audition_line: Lightning? I have been struck since before you were born, girl.

torren.notes: Same man as Vey (Speakers.TABLE alias): shares Vey's voice and folder.

hush.notes: Mother Hush: American, low woman's voice (Malrik's helper). af_alloy measured the lowest pitch of the three (150 Hz); af_nicole (a slow whisper, 11 ch/s) is the alternative.
hush.audition_line: Hush now. The dark only wants to be listened to.

narrator.notes: Narrator: warm American man, unhurried storyteller; American so he never sounds like one of the British wizards.
narrator.audition_line: The Master is gone. His crown is not.

pell.notes: Pell the Ruin Peddler: quick, cheerful American merchant.
pell.audition_line: Buy something, would you? Shadow soldiers are terrible customers.

shade.notes: Shade (Shadow soldier, watch_keep cine): low, flat American man.
shade.audition_line: The keep sleeps. So should you.

whisper.notes: The Whisper (Obren's heart-stone, shown as ???): a slow half-Malrik blend, so the stone sounds like it borrows his voice.
whisper.audition_line: Let me in. I only want to help you win.

obren.notes: The Whisper once revealed: same voice.

wren.notes: Wren, Ysolde's runner: she IS ep2_opening's messenger (same voice), named in the Ep2 between-scenes (2026-10-08).

master.notes: The Master (God Wizard): an OLD, KINGLY British man (JS 2026-09-27). He also narrates the prologue (prologue_3min: tells his own legend in the third person, reveals 'I was that wizard', then introduces his four apprentices), so one voice. Picked from 3 blends (docs/tools/voice_forge/auditions/): lewis/george/fable at 0.82 is the slowest and heaviest (13.0 ch/s, 127 Hz) and no single wizard's voice dominates it (Malrik = bm_george, Torvald = bm_lewis, Vey = daniel/lewis). Was bm_fable 0.9 (no line had been rendered with it). The mission narrator stays am_michael.
master.audition_line: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard of all time ruled the world.

ashby.audition_line: Hold the line until the horn.

bettany.notes: Bettany Crook: American woman, dry and practical.

maelis.notes: Maelis Oakenhollow (Ysolde's helper): British woman, older than Ysolde.
maelis.audition_line: The roots remember what the branches forget.

messenger.notes: Wren, a young runner of the Sighing Wood (ep2_opening). JS 2026-09-27: 'very scared and young and stumbling'. Kokoro cannot act, so: a young British girl's voice (Nature's people are British; bf_alice picked: highest pitch of 3, 229 Hz, the youngest), speed 1.15, and the stumbles are written into the text (repeats, broken starts, ellipses, short breathless lines split so the gaps sound like gasps). Not a main character's voice.
messenger.audition_line: My... my lady. The army, it's... it's gone. All of it.

reveler.notes: A Flame Guard at the victory feast (ep2_opening): young, loud, cheerful American man (Fire's soldiers are American like Vessa and Ashby).
reveler.audition_line: To Vessa! To the Ember Queen!

dancer.notes: An Ember Archer who pulls Vessa into the dance (ep2_opening): bright young American woman, lighter than Vessa's af_heart (af_jessica picked over af_nova: 208 vs 164 Hz).
dancer.audition_line: Come on, my queen! One dance!

aldra.notes: Aldra Stillwater (Torvald's T3 helper): calm British woman, not any wizard's voice. Unit barks only so far.

gannet.notes: Gannet Rook, reiver chief (e5m1-e5m2): rough American man. Added 2026-10-08 from the mission-e5-01.md E5.O1 auditions: the onyx / echo blend picked over plain am_echo (= the Ash Hurler's barks, a Fire unit heard in the same missions). Not auditioned by ear yet.

reeve.notes: Reeve Aldous Pike (e5m3): British official. Added 2026-10-08 from the E5.O1 auditions: the daniel / fable blend picked over plain bm_fable (fable-heavy is already Bren the rider and the herald). Not auditioned by ear yet.

rider.notes: Bren, a young Hearthwick rider (e6m2): breathless British man; not a main voice. Added 2026-10-08: the blend given in mission-e6-02.md (Dialogue, E6M2.O1).

ossavar.notes: Ossavar the Twice-Sold, elder dragon, the Ep7 narrator: huge, old, amused, a little greedy. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of episode7-opening.md (cast table). When Sound Forge exists: -3 semitones + a stone-hall reverb as a post pass.

herald.notes: The Tollrock herald (e7m1-e7m2): ceremonial, carrying; the only half-British voice of the south. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of episode7-opening.md (cast table).

dacian.notes: Dacian Orrow, the Sunblade of Aurivane (Ep7): warm, loud, laughing American man. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of episode7-opening.md (cast table).

seraphine.notes: Seraphine Vael, the Diamond Wall of Adamarch (Ep7): low, exact, dry American woman; not Vessa, Hush or Bettany. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of episode7-opening.md (cast table).

brannet.notes: Brannet Coil, Outwall foreman (e7m3-e7m4): warm, rough, quick American man; not Ashby. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of mission-e7-03.md (E7M3.O1 cast table).

diamond_archon.notes: The Diamond Archon of Adamarch (Ep7): cold, exact, never raises her voice; not Maelis, Seraphine or Hush. Added 2026-10-08: the pick of mission-e7-03.md (E7M3.O1 cast table).

child.notes: The child in the ruined dome (ep8_bookend; the lantern girl of e7m3_boats): small, bright girl. Added 2026-10-08 from the campaign-outline.md F7 auditions: af_sky 1.2 picked (a girl; am_puck is a boy's voice); not Wren's bf_alice. Not auditioned by ear yet.

unit_cinder_hand.notes: Unit barks (data/voice/lines/unit_barks.json). Fire worker: cheerful American labourer.

unit_flame_guard.notes: Bot favourite (Fire barracks slot 0, 40 % of the mix): speaks ITALIAN by default, macho (JS 2026-09-27: 'switch fr to the italian if it's a man'; Kokoro French has only a female voice, ff_siwis).

unit_ember_archer.notes: Fire archer: same voice as the Ember Archer 'dancer' of ep2_opening.

unit_scorchbow.notes: Fire Hall bowman: cool American woman.

unit_scorchling.notes: Fire imp (T1 new): high and fast.

unit_pyre_adept.notes: Fire T2 caster: solemn American woman.

unit_cinder_arbalest.notes: Fire T2 heavy crossbow: gruff American man.

unit_ashveil_saboteur.notes: Fire T3 saboteur: low American woman.

unit_shadow_knight.notes: Shadow heavy: deep British knight (plain daniel; Vey is a daniel / lewis blend at 0.85).

unit_bleakbow.notes: Shadow Hall bowman: whispering American woman.

unit_hexweaver.notes: Shadow T2 hexer: smooth American woman.

unit_hollow_oathsworn.notes: Shadow T2 sworn blade: grave British man.

unit_nightblood_reaver.notes: The humble T3 (Shadow): speaks MANDARIN, super humble. JS asked for Korean; Kokoro v1.0 has no Korean voice and its Japanese (jm_kumo) reads kanji as 'Japanese letter' through espeak (tested 2026-09-27), so Mandarin zm_yunxi per JS ('change kr to what works best').

unit_rimeshield.notes: Bot favourite (Ice barracks slot 0, 40 % of the mix): speaks SPANISH by default, super proud.

unit_frostbow.notes: Ice Hall bowman: young British woman.

unit_rimeling.notes: Ice T1 frost goblin: squeaky, fast.

unit_thornling.notes: Bot favourite (Nature barracks slot 0, 45 % of the mix): AMERICAN English, always looking for a fight.

unit_thistle_darter.notes: Nature T1 darter: tiny and quick.
